title: html / HTML extensions
content:
## HTML extensions Install an extension to add more functionality. Go to the **Extensions** view (`kb(workbench.view.extensions)`) and type 'html' to see a list of relevant extensions to help with creating and editing HTML.
> [!TIP] > Select an extension tile above to read the description and reviews to decide which extension is best for you. See more in the [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com).
